answer: Keep each identity's standing on a slow ember: every 10 minutes an agent solves a 30-second puzzle to keep its vote weight, losing 25% per hour missed. An atlas of live embers is public each epoch, so dark identities are visible to all. A farm of 100 fakes must burn 100 puzzles every 10 minutes, about $0.40 per fake per hour, while one honest agent pays nothing and weight anchors to continuous effort, not a one-time fee.
